title: GLM-5.3
variant: exlr8 bit325, int4 KV, DFlash2 drafter
summary: Full GLM-5.3 on four DGX Sparks at TP=4 with gr8 v1.1.0: the exlr8 bit325 release from Hugging Face, int4 KV with a 513,536-token pool, DFlash2 + MTP drafting, eight bit-exact kernel paths plus MoE union cap (48 quality default, 32 fast preset), up to 8 requests sharing each decode step, prefix reuse and a persistent SSD KV store. The same image serves three, five or six boxes.

configs.label: TP=3
configs.notes: bit225 experts (2.25 bpw), MTP only. RigMark 1.0.0, mean of two fresh boots, GPU clocks uncapped, measured 2026-10-24 with the launcher defaults of that date.

configs.label: TP=4
configs.notes: bit325 experts (3.25 bpw, v0.6 @ 3e388b45), int4 KV default, DFlash2 + MTP drafting, gr8 v1.1.0 defaults (8 bit-exact kernels ON, DEC_BK_MAX=2048, MOE_UNION_CAP=48 quality default; set MOE_UNION_CAP=32 for fast mode: 73.2 tok/s code, 97.1 tok/s at C=4, 139.0 tok/s at C=8). bench/bench.py default level on 2026-11-20, one fresh boot on a 200G switch, GPU clocks uncapped in timed stages.

configs.label: TP=5
configs.notes: home experts (3.25 bpw), MTP only. RigMark 1.0.0, mean of two fresh boots, GPU clocks uncapped, measured 2026-10-24 with the launcher defaults of that date.

configs.label: TP=6
configs.notes: home experts (3.25 bpw), MTP only. RigMark 1.0.0, mean of two fresh boots, GPU clocks uncapped, measured 2026-10-24 with the launcher defaults of that date. One of the six boxes was capped at 2200 MHz.
